title: «Why do I have to continue?»: The problem of motor learning for students with disabilities in an electronic format
reason: Quasi-experiment with four groups comparing changes in motor-test results and VO2max plus self-reported motivation, engagement and load; no platform-recorded measure of e-learning activity enters any analysis.

extraction.design: quasi-experimental, 2 intervention + 2 control groups, 12 weeks + 6-week follow-up
extraction.n_quote: participants who successfully completed the training was 78 (without sex stratification) aged
extraction.population: students training as sports coaches, incl. students with hearing or musculoskeletal disabilities
extraction.outcome_or_construct: intrinsic/extrinsic motivation, engagement (questionnaires), RPE, motor tests, VO2max
extraction.notes: Secondary NOREL (self-report constructs). Country from author affiliations (Kharkiv, Ukraine).
